notes.title: Orangeblood is a non-terrible JRPG trying too hard to sound cool
notes.content:
I haven’t alienated a section of our audience for ages. How many of you like JRPGs? Stand up, come on. Don’t be shy. I won’t point and laugh and call them all terrible.

Orangeblood is a JRPG about hip hop. It is about gangsta rap, thus unfortunately preoccupied with guns, murder and posturing. But as a setting for a game about combat… yeah, okay. That makes sense. And I can’t deny that the beats were solid enough to get me tapping. More importantly though, I’ve played it for a short while and the combat doesn’t make me wish it was a person so I could hit it with a brick.

(more…)

notes.title: Regarding a Bug which prevents story progression.
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

We have identified and are currently fixing a bug that prevents story progression.
[list]
[*] Before obtaining the Quest item “Master Key”, if you take the elevator from the Sunrise Hotel Deck area to the 16F you will get stuck behind a one way door and will be unable to progress further.
[/list]
We are currently working on a fix for this bug so we recommend that you do not take this elevator to the 16F before obtaining the Master Key.

We apologize for this inconvenience and will be sure to fix this issue as soon as we are able.

We hope you continue enjoying Orangeblood and will work our hardest to provide the possible user experience possible.

notes.title: Orangeblood Available Worldwide Now!
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

Orangeblood has finally dropped!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042670/Orangeblood/?l=japanese


[h2]It’s all about optimizing your loadouts![/h2]
Settle your uhh disagreements on New Koza with turn based Gun Fights.
Don’t forget to grind some levels, just like the old school JRPGs…
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/eaf970adaa9666e631cede42a200921620a86ef9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/91ef8b3900a0e103b0122837a70685b20afc808c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/8584baa7e36c9a65a567da52094463ade0f7454e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/ca4b21110668d45c1ca73d2843bce47175a54268.png[/img][/url]

The loot drops are random, so choosing the most effective guns, shoes and accessories is your key to building effective battle strategies.
Weapons that appear useless at first may work well depending on how you set up your team!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/a212c70c1c76656d55367f2ed20c5cc4b2bf4621.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/94d30292367e0bf0eea79e754083f1111ceb8b1f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/8f089f2372f45abdd64e82ba5696be025fe5bfbb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140584/82d788c873218601938a72b09f61d227a1cccc7c.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Game Highlights[/h2][list]
[*] Finely detailed pixel art, New Koza has been designed to look exotic wherever you hail from.
[*] An interesting take on Okinawa at the close of the 20th Century, in a timeline different than our own.
[*] A story which unfolds with little exposition, in the style of a movie.
[*] Up tempo, refreshing turn based gun combat.
[*] Loadout customization, create unique builds from a near infinite selection of weapons.
[*] A dope soundtrack, heavily influenced by 90s hip hop.
[*] You can get a pet dog.
[/list]


[h2]The soundtrack is dropping simultaneously!![/h2]
12 phenomenal tracks, all signed off by Grayfax, produced by PLAYISM.
Touting a 90s hip hop vibe, all 12 dope tracks for your listening pleasure.[olist]
[*] Freakmode

notes.title: Change of Release Date Announcement.
notes.content:
PLAYISM has been working very closely with the developer of Orangeblood, Grayfax Software, towards the release of the game. As publisher we have supported Grayfax with the music composition and also with localization and QA. However, both the developer and we agree that there are still a few kinks that need to be straightened out in order for players to have the best gaming experience possible with this title.
Therefore we have decided to shift the release date from November 2019 to early 2020.

We apologize to those who were looking forward to getting into the action this autumn and ask for your continued patience while we brush up the game to its fullest potential.

We will inform you of the release date as soon as it is confirmed.
